title: Facilities Maintenance Technician
company: Aaron Manor Nursing and Rehabilitation Center
description:
Competitive Wages & Benefits Plan!
Aaron Manor is looking for Maintenance Workers for our family-operated nursing home in Fairport, NY. There are unique differences to being part of a family-owned and operated business.  Each and every employee is critically necessary to create and maintain a balanced, efficient, and effective workplace.  Every voice matters in our efforts every day.  Through mutual respect for each other, active listening, and good communication, we together create a working atmosphere that strives to achieve best practice both clinically and financially. If this sounds like something you're looking for in a job, please apply!
Job Summary: Under the Direction of the Maintenance Director, the Maintenance Worker is responsible for the maintenance operations of the facility including the performance of repairs and maintenance of equipment and supplies. Performs regular monthly maintenance preventative checks, and work assignments. Follows established safety rules and policies, procedures of the home.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Representative Duties: (including but not limited to)

Reports to Maintenance Director equipment or modifications needed to provide resident care.
Ensures work areas are kept clean, neat, and safe.
Maintains the building and grounds in good repair.
Completes all maintenance work orders and documents completion.
Supports and maintains a culture of safety and quality.
Maintains the facility free from hazards caused by electrical, plumbing, heating and cooling system

Skills:

Basic computer knowledge.
Basic Plumbing, Electrical & Constructive knowledge.
